title: Power rating targets rescaled at the top tiers
summary: This version retunes the recommended-power reference the game grades your progress against: the target power and the C-to-SSS rating brackets shown for each progression area. No Palmon's actual power changes. All 14 areas, from hero level, star and skill through buildings, Armigo, mount, commander gear, Dream Island, S3 gems, tech, achievements and boss training, have their top five tiers rescaled, and the hero skill ladder is retuned across its full range.
highlights: The top five tiers (31 to 35) of all 14 progression areas are rescaled: tier 31 stays roughly level or edges up, and every tier above it is cut further.
The deepest cuts land at tier 35, where the recommended power falls to 0.49x its old value for tech, 0.56x for achievements, 0.65x for hero evolution and mount, and 0.72x for hero level.
Hero level tier 31 moves from 91,000,000 to 85,800,000 recommended power, and tier 35 from 173,500,000 to 125,600,000.
56 recommended-power values fall and 18 rise; outside the hero skill ladder the rises are small first-tier adjustments of 1 to 9 percent across eight areas.
The hero skill ladder is retuned across all 35 levels, with the low end raised: levels 1 to 6 go from 2,070 to 3,000 and level 9 from 4,220 to 10,000.
All 99 changed rows also move their C-to-SSS rating brackets, and no rows are added or removed.
